title: 第9章 没事这软饭好吃第10章 麻烦你再揍揍我
lines: “我能助你通过考核，也同样能毁了你拥有的一切。”
“是吗？我不太相信。”
萧焰指着面前九龙塔，笑着说道：“任何人想要进入九龙塔，都需要积分，你刚刚进入宗门，身份令牌内只有一个积分，不够资格进入。”
直接选择无视。
现在不是报仇的时候。
修为还未恢复，并且湮鼎宗有着宗规，等时机成熟，他会让萧焰连本带利还给自己。
来到九龙塔前。
林铮将手里的身份令牌放在凹槽上，提示积分不足，无法进入。
“哈哈，林铮，我已经告诉过你，想要进入九龙塔需要积分，你还是回去好好想办法，等赚到积分再来。”
“林大哥，我有积分。”
黄鹂般的声音传来，洛清漪突然走到林铮身边，递出自己的身份令牌，说道：“里面的积分，足够你修炼一个月。”
“洛清漪？”
“原来她就是洛清漪，好漂亮。”
“洛清漪是谁？我怎么从未听说过咱们湮鼎宗还有这么一号人物。”
“你消息太闭塞了，听说洛清漪觉醒了皇品血脉，还是冰风血脉，被宗主收为关门弟子。”
坐轮椅的残疾？
原本准备继续好好嘲讽林铮的萧焰，看着突然出现的身影，整个人都愣住了。
他当然认识洛清漪，三焱城城主的养女，天生绝脉，双腿残疾，一直坐轮椅，被三焱城誉为坐在轮椅上的美女。
“清漪妹妹，你还认识我吗？”
“二皇子？”
萧焰笑着说道：“看来清漪妹妹还没有忘记我，真是没有想到，清漪妹妹竟然是绝世天才，觉醒了皇品血脉，前两天师父赐我一枚聚灵丹，我想借花献佛，将这枚聚灵丹送给你。”
看着递过来的玉瓶，清漪并未伸手去接，冷冷道：“无功不受禄，你还是自己留着。”
“清漪妹妹。”
“萧焰，请你放尊重点，我有名字，你可以喊我洛清漪，或者是洛师妹，这个所谓的妹妹，你最好不要再喊。”
一点面子都不给。
萧焰能看的出来，洛清漪似乎对林铮有意思。
失策，真是失策！
早知道洛清漪拥有皇品血脉，当初就应该亲自去提亲，白白错失机会。
“洛师妹，我要提醒你，林铮和洛雪有婚约。”
“没有了。”
“什么意思？”
“洛雪和林大哥之间的婚约已经解除，现在我们两人有婚约。”
羡慕嫉妒恨！
萧焰却没有任何的办法，狠狠瞪了林铮一眼，心里将林铮狠狠揍了一顿，转身就走。
“这小子真是走了狗屎运，竟然和洛清漪有婚约。”
“觉醒皇品血脉，洛清漪日后前途不可限量，说不定还会成为下一任宗主，夫凭妻贵，羡慕死我了。”
林铮并未说一句话，他和萧焰之间的恩怨，唯有生死才能解决。
“我先进去了。”
“林大哥，我现在将积分全部划到你的身份令牌，稍后我会每隔一个月给你一次，积分问题你不要管，只需要好好修炼。”
很是感动。
林铮笑着问道：“想让我吃软饭？”
content_en:
"I can help you pass the exam, but I can also destroy everything you have."
"Really? I don't really believe it."
Xiao Yan pointed at the Nine Dragon Tower in front of him and said with a smile: "Anyone who wants to enter the Nine Dragon Tower needs points. You have just entered the sect and your identity token only has one point, so you are not qualified to enter."
Just choose to ignore it.
Now is not the time for revenge.
His cultivation level has not yet recovered, and the Annihilation Cauldron Sect has sect rules. When the time is right, he will let Xiao Yan return the money to him with profits.
Come to the Kowloon Tower.
Lin Zheng placed the identity token in his hand on the groove, indicating that he had insufficient points and could not enter.
"Haha, Lin Zheng, I've already told you that you need points to enter the Nine Dragons Tower. You'd better go back and think of a way and come back after you earn the points."
"Brother Lin, I have points."
A voice like an oriole came, and Luo Qingyi suddenly walked up to Lin Zheng, handed over his identity token, and said: "The points in it are enough for you to practice for a month."
"Luo Qingyi?"
"It turns out she is Luo Qingyi, so beautiful."
"Who is Luo Qingyi? Why have I never heard of such a number one figure in our Diding Sect?"
"You have too little information. I heard that Luo Qingyi awakened the imperial bloodline, or the ice wind bloodline, and was accepted as a closed disciple by the sect master."
Wheelchair disabled?
Xiao Yan, who was originally planning to continue mocking Lin Zheng, was stunned when he saw the figure that suddenly appeared.
Of course he knew Luo Qingyi, the adopted daughter of the city lord of Sanyan City. She was born with inexhaustible pulses, disabled legs, and has always been in a wheelchair. She was praised by Sanyan City as a beauty in a wheelchair.
"Sister Qingyi, do you still know me?"
"Second Prince?"
Xiao Yan said with a smile: "It seems that sister Qingyi has not forgotten me yet. I really didn't expect that sister Qingyi is a peerless genius and has awakened the imperial bloodline. Master gave me a spirit-gathering pill two days ago. I would like to borrow a flower to offer this spirit-gathering pill to you."
Looking at the jade bottle handed to her, Qingyi did not reach out to take it, but said coldly: "No reward for no merit, you should keep it for yourself."
"Sister Qingyi."
"Xiao Yan, please be respectful. I have a name. You can call me Luo Qingyi, or Junior Sister Luo. This so-called sister, you'd better stop calling me."
No face given at all.
Xiao Yan could tell that Luo Qingyi seemed to be interested in Lin Zheng.
What a mistake! What a mistake!
If he had known that Luo Qingyi had imperial bloodline, he should have gone to propose marriage in person and missed the opportunity.
"Junior Sister Luo, I want to remind you that Lin Zheng and Luo Xue are engaged."
"No more."
"What do you mean?"
"The engagement between Luo Xue and Brother Lin has been terminated, and now the two of us are engaged."
"Hmph!"
Envy, jealousy and hate!
Xiao Yan had no choice but to give Lin Zheng a hard look, beat him up in his heart, and turned around to leave.
"This kid is so lucky that he is engaged to Luo Qingyi."
"Awakening the imperial bloodline, Luo Qingyi's future is limitless, and he might even become the next sect master. A husband is more important than his wife, and I'm so jealous of her."
Lin Zheng didn't say a word. The grudge between him and Xiao Yan could only be resolved by life and death.
"I'll go in first."
"Brother Lin, I will transfer all the points to your identity token now. I will give it to you every other month later. You don't have to worry about the points. You just need to practice well."
Very touched.
Lin Zheng smiled and asked: "You want me to eat soft rice?"
title_en: Chapter 9 It’s okay, this soft rice is delicious Chapter 10 Please beat me again
